name: Divine Grace
summary: High Priestess Laurena calls you to Stormwind’s Cathedral of Light because your superiors have approved further training. Your lessons in the ways of the Light are ready to begin.

sections.title: A Call to Stormwind
sections.body: Your superiors send you to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind after judging that you have proven yourself. There, High Priestess Laurena is ready to guide your further training. She says there are lessons every servant of the Light must learn, and she is prepared to discuss them with you.

faq.q: Why am I being sent to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Your superiors believe you have proven yourself and have approved further training in the ways of the Light.
High Priestess Laurena is in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind and is ready to guide your training.

faq.q: Where do I find High Priestess Laurena?
faq.answer: High Priestess Laurena is at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
Laurena is prepared to discuss lessons that all servants of the Light must learn.

angles.text: As a priest, your superiors have approved further training in the ways of the Light.
